title: A comprehensive review of atomically precise metal nanoclusters with emergent photophysical properties towards diverse applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00962B, Review Article
Subarna Maity, Sarita Kolay, Sikta Chakraborty, Aarti Devi, Rashi, Amitava Patra
Ligand-protected metal nanoclusters are an emerging class of nanomaterials at the interface of the atomic and plasmonic regimes with unique photophysical and electrochemical properties, leading to diverse applications.
